name: hive
description: Orchestration dashboard for managing Claude Code agents

scripts.dev:clean: pnpm kill; sleep 2; pnpm reset && rm -rf .vite node_modules/.vite && electron-forge start
scripts.kill: pkill -9 -f 'electron.*claude-deck' 2>/dev/null; pkill -9 -f 'vite.*claude-deck' 2>/dev/null; pkill -9 -f 'electron-forge' 2>/dev/null; echo 'All processes killed'
scripts.reset: rm -f "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/claude-deck.db" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/claude-deck.db-wal" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/claude-deck.db-shm" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/manager-state.json" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/notifications-cache.json" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/plans-cache.json" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/planning-events-cache.json" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/projects-cache.json" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/skipped-cache.json" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/business-context.md" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/business-context.log" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/reflect-history.json" && rm -rf "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/Local Storage" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/Session Storage" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/claude-deck/IndexedDB" && echo 'All app data reset'
